title: Palpation of Spinal Levels — C7, T3, T7, L4 and S2

hook.en: Finding the right spinal level by touch is a skill that needs landmarks, patience and honesty about error. Learn five landmarks that mark the spine and how to cross-check them.
hook.ur: Touch se sahi spinal level dhoondna aisa hunar hai jis ko landmarks, sabr aur ghalti ke baare mein imandari chahiye. Paanch landmarks seekhein jo spine ko mark karte hain aur unhein cross-check kaise karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll find C7, the scapular spine (T3), the inferior angle (T7), the iliac crests (L4) and the PSIS (S2) and use them together instead of trusting one.
goal.ur: End tak aap C7, scapular spine (T3), inferior angle (T7), iliac crests (L4) aur PSIS (S2) dhoondenge aur ek par bharosa karne ke bajaye unhein saath use karenge.

text.en: Spinal levels are located by **bony landmarks that you can feel**. **C7** (vertebra prominens) is the most prominent bump at the base of the neck; the **root of the scapular spine** lies level with the **T3** spinous process; the **inferior angle of the scapula** is level with **T7**; the **highest points of the iliac crests** line up with **L4** (Tuffier's line); and the **PSIS** (the dimples) is level with **S2**. Use several landmarks together because each alone is often a level out.
text.ur: Spinal levels **mehsoos hone wale bony landmarks** se dhoondte hain. **C7** (vertebra prominens) gardan ke base par sab se numaya bump hai; **scapular spine ki root** **T3** spinous process ke barabar hoti hai; **scapula ka inferior angle** **T7** ke barabar; **iliac crests ke sab se unchay points** **L4** (Tuffier's line) ke barabar; aur **PSIS** (dimples) **S2** ke barabar. Kayi landmarks saath use karein kyunke har ek akela aksar ek level ghalat hota hai.

text.en: Spinal landmarks are like road signs on a long journey. One sign can be misleading or missing, but if three signs agree you are confident where you are. When two disagree, stop and check again rather than pretending you are certain.
text.ur: Spinal landmarks lambe safar ke road signs jaise hain. Ek sign ghalat ya ghayab ho sakta hai, lekin teen signs agree karein to aap ko yaqeen hota hai ke aap kahan hain. Do mein farq ho to yaqeen ka dikhawa karne ke bajaye ruk kar dobara check karein.

intro.en: Flex the neck and run a finger down the back of the neck to the most prominent bump. Then **extend the neck**: C7 stays still while C6 slides forward and disappears. That movement is your confirmation that the bump is C7 and not T1.
intro.ur: Gardan ko flex karein aur gardan ke peechay finger sab se numaya bump tak chalayein. Phir **gardan ko extend** karein: C7 apni jagah rehta hai jabke C6 aage slide karke ghayab ho jata hai. Yeh movement aap ki tasdeeq hai ke bump C7 hai, T1 nahi.

question.en: How do you confirm that the prominent bump is C7 and not T1?
question.ur: Aap kaise tasdeeq karte hain ke numaya bump C7 hai T1 nahi?

text.en: Extend the neck: C7 stays still while C6 moves forward and disappears
text.ur: Gardan extend karein: C7 saakin rehta hai jabke C6 aage ja kar ghayab ho jata hai

feedback.en: Yes — C6 glides forward with extension, T1 does not move, so the bump that stays is C7 (or T1 in a few people); combine with counting upwards.
feedback.ur: Haan — C6 extension ke saath aage slide karta hai, T1 nahi hilta, is liye jo bump rehta hai woh C7 hai (ya kuch logon mein T1); upar ki taraf ginti ke saath milayein.

text.en: It is always the biggest bump on the spine
text.ur: Yeh hamesha spine ka sab se bara bump hota hai

feedback.en: In some people T1 is larger.
feedback.ur: Kuch logon mein T1 bara hota hai.

text.en: It is level with the nipples
text.ur: Yeh nipples ke barabar hota hai

feedback.en: The nipple line is about T4 in men.
feedback.ur: Nipple line mardon mein takriban T4 hoti hai.

intro.en: Palpate the ridge across the upper back, starting where it meets the medial border. The **root of the spine** lies level with the T3 spinous process. Combine it with the inferior angle (T7) and C7 to cross-check.
intro.ur: Upper back par ridge ko wahan se palpate karein jahan woh medial border se milti hai. **Spine ki root** T3 spinous process ke barabar hoti hai. Cross-check ke liye isay inferior angle (T7) aur C7 ke saath milayein.

intro.en: Rest the hands on the hips and press down on top of the pelvis to find the **highest point of the crest**. A line joining the two highest points (**Tuffier's line**) passes through the L4 spinous process (or the L4–L5 space). Use it to count to the lumbar level you need.
intro.ur: Haath hips par rakh kar pelvis ke upar neeche dabayein aur crest ka **sab se unchaa point** dhoondein. Dono unchay points ko milane wali line (**Tuffier's line**) L4 spinous process (ya L4–L5 space) se guzarti hai. Isay apni zaroorat ke lumbar level tak ginne ke liye use karein.

title.ur: Paanch landmarks aur un ke levels

rows.en: Confirm with neck extension; T1 may be larger in some people
rows.ur: Neck extension se confirm karein; kuch logon mein T1 bara ho sakta hai

rows.en: Arms by the side; check both sides
rows.ur: Arms side mein; dono sides check karein

rows.en: Arms by the side; differs with scapular position
rows.ur: Arms side mein; scapular position se farq

rows.en: Highest point of the iliac crests
rows.ur: Iliac crests ka sab se unchaa point

rows.en: May be one level out; count down from L4 and up from the sacrum
rows.ur: Ek level ghalat ho sakta hai; L4 se neeche aur sacrum se upar ginein

rows.en: Compare both sides for pelvic asymmetry
rows.ur: Pelvic asymmetry ke liye dono sides compare karein

text.en: **Trusting one landmark and not re-checking.** Counting up from the sacrum, down from C7 or across from the iliac crests can each give a different level; palpation of a single level is wrong by one level in a large proportion of attempts, and agreement between therapists is only moderate. Use several landmarks, repeat the count from the other end, mark with a skin pen and record "approximately L4–L5". If your clinical decision depends on the exact level, request imaging instead of guessing.
text.ur: **Ek landmark par bharosa aur dobara check na karna.** Sacrum se upar ginna, C7 se neeche ya iliac crests se across — har ek mukhtalif level de sakta hai; ek level ki palpation bohat se mauqon par ek level ghalat hoti hai, aur therapists ke beech agreement sirf moderate hai. Kayi landmarks use karein, doosre sirey se ginti dohrayein, skin pen se mark karein aur “takriban L4–L5” likhein. Agar aap ka clinical faisla bilkul sahi level par depend karta hai to andaza lagane ke bajaye imaging manga lein.

question.en: Your count from C7 and your count from the iliac crests disagree by one level. What is the best action?
question.ur: Aap ki C7 se ginti aur iliac crests se ginti mein ek level ka farq hai. Behtareen action?

text.en: Repeat with other landmarks, record the level as approximate and avoid decisions that need an exact level
text.ur: Doosre landmarks se dohrayein, level ko takreeban likhein aur aise faislon se bachein jin ko bilkul sahi level chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — honest uncertainty is safer than false precision.
feedback.ur: Haan — imandar be-yaqeeni jhoote yaqeen se mehfooz hai.

text.en: Choose the count you prefer and carry on
text.ur: Jo ginti pasand ho usay chun kar aage barhein
Hamesha iliac crests par bharosa karein

feedback.en: The crests are one of several landmarks and vary with pelvic tilt.
feedback.ur: Crests kayi landmarks mein se ek hain aur pelvic tilt ke saath badalte hain.

text.en: **Where levels matter.** Level matters for mobilisation technique, for spinal injections and for counting ribs (the sternal angle marks the 2nd rib). Record the level with the landmarks used ("L4 spinous process by Tuffier's line, confirmed from S2") so a colleague can repeat it. For a spinal cord injury exam the sensory key points are defined by dermatomes, not by vertebral palpation, so use the standard points instead.
text.ur: **Level kahan ahem hai.** Level mobilisation technique, spinal injections aur ribs ginne ke liye ahem hai (sternal angle 2nd rib ko mark karta hai). Level ko istemal hue landmarks ke saath likhein (“L4 spinous process Tuffier ki line se, S2 se confirm”) taake colleague dohra sake. Spinal cord injury exam mein sensory key points dermatomes se tay hote hain, vertebral palpation se nahi, is liye standard points use karein.

text.en: Palpation of a single spinal level is **often out by one level or more**: studies comparing palpation with X-ray find that therapists locate the intended level correctly only about a third to a half of the time, with the error worse in larger bodies and in the thoracic spine. Agreement between therapists on "stiffness" is also low. This does not make palpation useless; it means it should be combined, cross-checked and documented as approximate.
text.ur: Ek spinal level ki palpation **aksar ek level ya zyada ghalat** hoti hai: palpation ka X-ray se muqabla karne wali studies paati hain ke therapists matloob level ko sirf aik tihai se aadhe waqt sahi dhoondte hain, bare jism aur thoracic spine mein ghalti zyada. “Stiffness” par therapists ke beech agreement bhi kam hai. Is ka matlab palpation bekaar nahi; matlab isay milana, cross-check karna aur takreeban likhna chahiye.

question.en: Why does extending the neck help find C7?
question.ur: Gardan extend karne se C7 dhoondna aasan kyun hota hai?

answer.en: Because C6 (and C5) glide forward in extension while C7, tethered by the thoracic spine, barely moves. The bump that stays still while the one above it disappears is C7.
answer.ur: Kyunke extension mein C6 (aur C5) aage slide karte hain jabke C7, thoracic spine se bandha hone ki wajah se mushkil se hilta hai. Jo bump saakin rahe aur us ke upar wala ghayab ho jaye woh C7 hai.

question.en: Which landmark marks the L4 level?
question.ur: Kaun sa landmark L4 level ko mark karta hai?

text.en: The line joining the highest points of the iliac crests (Tuffier's line)
text.ur: Iliac crests ke sab se unchay points ko milane wali line (Tuffier's line)

feedback.en: Yes — it passes through the L4 spinous process or the L4–L5 space.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh L4 spinous process ya L4–L5 space se guzarti hai.

text.en: The inferior angle of the scapula

feedback.ur: Yeh T7 ko mark karta hai.
PSIS S2 ko mark karta hai.

text.en: **Stop and refer** if palpation finds a hot, red, swollen area with fever, a pulsatile abdominal mass, severe midline spinal tenderness after trauma, or a hard, fixed, painless lump. Do not use spinal palpation as a reason to apply pressure to a suspected fracture or to the neck after trauma.
text.ur: **Ruk jayein aur refer karein** agar palpation mein garam, laal, sooja hua hissa bukhar ke saath, dhadakta abdominal mass, trauma ke baad midline spine mein shadeed tenderness, ya sakht, jama hua, dard-rahit gaanth mile. Spinal palpation ko shak-e-fracture ya trauma ke baad gardan par dabao daalne ki wajah na banayein.

summary.en: C7, scapular spine (T3), inferior angle (T7), iliac crests (L4) and PSIS (S2) mark the spine; use them together.
summary.ur: C7, scapular spine (T3), inferior angle (T7), iliac crests (L4) aur PSIS (S2) spine ko mark karte hain; unhein saath use karein.

summary.en: Confirm C7 with neck extension, count from both ends and record the level as approximate.
summary.ur: C7 ki neck extension se tasdeeq karein, dono sirey se ginein aur level ko takreeban likhein.

summary.en: Single-level palpation is often one level out, so cross-check and request imaging if the exact level matters.
summary.ur: Ek level ki palpation aksar ek level ghalat hoti hai, is liye cross-check karein aur bilkul sahi level ahem ho to imaging manga lein.

front.en: Levels of the scapular spine root, inferior angle and iliac crests?
front.ur: Scapular spine root, inferior angle aur iliac crests ke levels?

back.en: The prominent bump at the base of the neck; on neck extension C6 glides forward and disappears, C7 stays.
back.ur: Gardan ke base par numaya bump; neck extension par C6 aage slide kar ke ghayab ho jata hai, C7 rehta hai.

front.en: How accurate is spinal level palpation?
front.ur: Spinal level palpation kitni accurate hai?

back.en: Often one level out; use several landmarks and document as approximate.
back.ur: Aksar ek level ghalat; kayi landmarks use karein aur takreeban likhein.
